release_read.basis: The thesis was a forced raise of the FY EBITDA guide; instead the guide was maintained with adjusted EBITDA now expected toward the LOWER end of 45-55% growth, Q3 adj. EBITDA $84m (19.1% margin, operational challenges, metal lag -$1m) and adj. EPS $1.89 vs Nasdaq's single-estimate $2.08. Against a 7.4% historical reaction scale, a guide-to-low-end on the line this stock trades on justifies a move of roughly -6%.

key_line.detail: Maintained at 45-55% growth but now expected toward the lower end; conversion revenue growth at the high end of 10-15%. No raise, which was the whole thesis.

guidance.detail: Formally maintained, but EBITDA steered to the lower end of the range (effectively a soft cut) where the panel expected a raise.

call.detail: Conference call Thursday 2026-10-22 at 10:00 ET, i.e. during the session; not yet held.

public_reaction.summary: No time to search analyst actions or retail tone before the 09:24 compile; media tone estimated from the release itself (margin compression, guide to low end).

tape_read.note: Robust reference 138.00 = -10.4% vs prev close 153.95, against a release read of -6% and a 7.4% historical move. After-hours sat at -6.2% (144.40) and the pre-market sagged from a high of 142.29 to 137.00; only 6 prints, stale_at_open true, SPY -0.9%. The pre-market looks like more than the release justifies, on thin trade.

thesis_check.note: The panel sized a forced FY EBITDA raise; the company kept the range and pointed to its lower end, with Q3 margins hit by operational challenges and no metal-lag tailwind.

expected.open_lag_note: Thin, stale pre-market (6 prints) that sagged below the -6% after-hours level makes the open uncertain; a -10% gap beyond the historical move on a soft-not-disastrous release tends to give some back by 10:00, but the 10:00 call is an event risk either way.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers spreken de these tegen: geen verhoging van de jaarprognose, de winst (EBITDA) wordt nu aan de onderkant verwacht. Maar de koers staat voorbeurs al ruim 10% lager, meer dan de cijfers rechtvaardigen (ongeveer -6%), op heel weinig handel. Wacht tot 10:00 op enig herstel en verkoop dan, net voordat de toelichting van het management begint.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugveert naar boven 144 (het nabeursniveau), is het herstel al ingeprijsd en is verkopen bij de opening beter.
